laws.rule: Saadani National Park, coastal Bagamoyo/Pangani area: fishing inside the park is not permitted. Boat activities use authorised operators, designated routes and lifejackets; do not approach turtle nests or disturb dunes/mangroves. These are named-park conditions, not a coast-wide fishing ban.

sources.title: Saadani coastal visitor regulations
sources.supports: Read directly: no fishing in park, quiet turtle/bird areas, authorised boat operators and designated tracks.

local-law.note: Named coastal park only. Exact regional park boundary and other local fishing licences not yet checked.
